title: 滤波器设计：基波全部通过，3 次谐波完全滤除
statement: v_s = 100√2 cos(1000t) + 20√2 cos(3000t) V。它经图示滤波电路接到负载 R = 50 Ω 上：L = 10 mH 与 C_1 并联，再串联 C_2。
要求输出 v_o 中**完全不含 3 次谐波**，而**基波全部加在负载上**（v_o1 = v_s1）。求 C_1、C_2，并验证输出。

questions.explain: 基波时 L∥C_1 的阻抗为 jωL/(1 − 1/9) = j11.25 Ω，C_2 与它对 ω 串联谐振：1/(ωC_2) = 11.25 Ω，C_2 = 88.89 µF。

questions.ask: 验证：v_o 的 3 次谐波有效值 V_o3 = ?
questions.explain: 3 次谐波被并联谐振的 L∥C_1 挡住，V_o3 = 0。

questions.ask: 验证：v_o 的基波有效值 V_o1 = ?
questions.explain: 基波时整个串联支路阻抗为零（串联谐振），V_o1 = V_s1 = 100 V。
串联支路阻抗为零，v_o1 = v_s1，初相 0°。

hints: 分两步：先让某个部分对 3 次谐波“开路”，再让整个串联支路对基波“短路”。
L∥C_1 对 3ω 并联谐振时阻抗无穷大，3 次谐波电流为零；由此求 C_1。
基波时 L∥C_1 不谐振，是一个感抗（算出来）；C_2 的容抗要与它相等，使串联支路对 ω 串联谐振。

en.title: Filter design: pass the whole fundamental, remove the 3rd harmonic
statement: v_s = 100√2 cos(1000t) + 20√2 cos(3000t) V feeds a load R = 50 Ω through the filter shown: L = 10 mH in parallel with C_1, then in series with C_2.
The output v_o must contain **no 3rd harmonic at all**, while the **whole fundamental reaches the load** (v_o1 = v_s1). Find C_1 and C_2 and check the output.
hints: Two steps: first make one part an “open circuit” at the 3rd harmonic, then make the whole series branch a “short circuit” at the fundamental.
L∥C_1 in parallel resonance at 3ω has infinite impedance and blocks the 3rd-harmonic current; that gives C_1.
At the fundamental L∥C_1 is not resonant but an inductive reactance (compute it); C_2's reactance must equal it so that the series branch is in series resonance at ω.
solution: **1. Remove the 3rd harmonic.** Put L∥C_1 in parallel resonance at 3ω: 9ω²LC_1 = 1, C_1 = 1/(9 × 1000² × 0.01) = **11.11 µF**. Then the 3rd-harmonic current is zero and V_o3 = **0**.

**2. Pass the whole fundamental.** At ω, ω²LC_1 = 1/9 and Z_{L∥C1} = jωL/(1 − 1/9) = j10 × 9/8 = j11.25 Ω (inductive). For zero series-branch impedance C_2 needs a reactance of 11.25 Ω: C_2 = 1/(1000 × 11.25) = **88.89 µF**.
**3. Output.** Fundamental: zero series impedance, V̇_o1 = V̇_s1 = **100∠0° V**; 3rd harmonic: 0. v_o = 100√2 cos(1000t) V.

questions.explain: L∥C_1 must be in parallel resonance (open) at 3ω: C_1 = 1/(9ω²L) = 1/(9 × 10⁶ × 0.01) = 11.11 µF.
At the fundamental L∥C_1 has impedance jωL/(1 − 1/9) = j11.25 Ω; C_2 must resonate with it in series at ω: 1/(ωC_2) = 11.25 Ω, C_2 = 88.89 µF.

questions.ask: Check: rms 3rd harmonic of v_o, V_o3 = ?
questions.explain: The 3rd harmonic is blocked by the parallel-resonant L∥C_1, V_o3 = 0.

questions.ask: Check: rms fundamental of v_o, V_o1 = ?
questions.explain: At the fundamental the whole series branch has zero impedance (series resonance), V_o1 = V_s1 = 100 V.

questions.ask: Initial phase of the fundamental of v_o = ?
questions.explain: The series branch has zero impedance, v_o1 = v_s1, initial phase 0°.
